name: App Icon: 2D Samurai Coin Kamon Seal
purpose: Primary 2D App Store Icon — Traditional Coin Clan Crest.
description: Traditional Japanese circular currency coin silhouette with square center hole and crossed black katanas, embedded in a deep crimson sun medallion.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game app icon. Traditional Japanese circular coin silhouette with a square center cutout, crossed pure solid black samurai katana swords, (centered inside a giant perfectly smooth solid circular crimson-red sun emblem:1.4). Pure flat 2D graphic art, solid pitch-black silhouette (#07080C), deep crimson red (#D20A2E), sharp geometric vector contours, high contrast, clean negative space, no 3D rendering, no gradients, no soft painting, no text, no typography, no pixelation.
